name: Noaberpad - 1
description_md:
Noaberpad - 1 is a waymarked hiking route in NL spanning 89.2 km. It features 492 m of ascent and 467 m of descent.

The path is signposted as LAW10 and belongs to the national waymarked hiking network. Walking this hard route takes about 24 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, with the difficulty derived from distance and ascent. During the journey, the route passes Bourtange within 100 m.
